Ybets Sportsbook is part of the wider Ybets platform, a crypto-focused gambling site launched in 2023 and operated by Sigg Marketing Limited under an Anjouan license.

While the brand is best known for its online casino and crypto promotions, the sportsbook has been built as a standalone betting product with an emphasis on live wagering, international markets, and fast crypto transactions.

The sportsbook interface features a modern, dark-themed design and an HTML5-based layout that performs smoothly across desktop and mobile browsers.

Football markets dominate the homepage, but bettors can also find extensive coverage across basketball, tennis, American football, baseball, esports, and a variety of niche betting markets.

In this review of Ybets Sportsbook, we break down the platform and focus on the features that make it one of the top international sportsbooks for bettors who use cryptocurrency for online gambling.

This review takes a look at betting options, its live betting platform and mobile functionality, promotions and rewards, banking options and limits, and important considerations around withdrawals and verification.

Do note that if you are from the U.S., you must use a VPN to access Ybets Sportsbook. However, unlike many top sports betting sites, Ybets actually permits VPN usage. For those looking to try somewhere new, this feature helps Ybets stand out in the crowd.

Bet on the FIFA World Cup at Ybets

The 2026 FIFA World Cup is the biggest event on this year’s sports calendar, and Ybets Sportsbook offers extensive coverage throughout the tournament. From group-stage matches to the final, bettors can expect a wide range of wagering options across every game.

Standard markets such as moneylines, totals, both teams to score, and handicap betting are available, while many matches also feature player props. Bettors can wager on the outright winner, Golden Boot race, group winners, and a variety of long-term markets throughout the competition.

Live betting is where Ybets particularly shines during major soccer tournaments. Odds update in real time, allowing bettors to react to goals, red cards, momentum swings, and other key moments as matches unfold. Given the volume of World Cup action taking place across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, the platform’s fast interface and responsive live betting menu are especially valuable.

For crypto bettors looking to follow the tournament from start to finish, Ybets provides a straightforward way to bet on the world’s biggest soccer event while taking advantage of fast cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals.

Does Ybets Sportsbook Have a Welcome Bonus?

At the time of writing, Ybets Sportsbook does not offer a sportsbook welcome bonus. The widely promoted 500% matched deposit bonus applies exclusively to casino play.

However, as of May 2026, customer support reports that Ybets is working on implementing sportsbook bonuses. A timeline was not mentioned but look out for that potential addition in the coming weeks and months.

Ybets Sportsbook Pros and Cons

Pros

20% cashback on sportsbook losses

Broad international sports coverage

No mandatory KYC up front in many cases

VPN access permitted

Cons

Ybets Sportsbook Features

Ybets Sportsbook uses a clean HTML5 interface designed for speed and accessibility rather than a downloadable app. Sports and leagues are organized clearly in a left-hand navigation menu, while featured events and top leagues are highlighted across the main betting screen.

Live betting remains the central focus of the platform. In-play matches display real-time scores, timers, and dynamically updating odds, with expandable markets and a fast, responsive bet slip. Bettors can filter live events by sport and quickly switch between multiple matches without performance issues.

Beyond the interface itself, Ybets distinguishes its sportsbook through platform-wide rewards that actively apply to sports betting.

These include a combined 20% cashback on sportsbook losses, access to the proprietary Engine of Fortune prize wheel with low wagering requirements, and VIP perks that extend to high-volume sports bettors.

For frequent in-play bettors, these features add tangible value beyond standard odds and markets.

Other Ybets Sportsbook Bonuses and Promotions

While Ybets does not offer a traditional sportsbook welcome bonus, it compensates with ongoing promotions that apply directly to sports betting.

The most notable is the Engine of Fortune, a proprietary prize wheel designed to deliver guaranteed rewards rather than lottery-style spins. Any deposit of $50 or more, regardless of whether it is intended for casino or sportsbook use, grants three Fortune Spins.

Prizes include direct crypto payouts (up to 5 BTC), bonus funds, cashback boosters, and balance top-ups that can be used for sports wagering.

Winnings from the Engine of Fortune typically carry a very low 3x wagering requirement, a far easier requirement to clear than standard bonus offers.

Spins must be used within a set time window, and all current spins must be exhausted before additional ones can be earned through new deposits.

Ybets also runs platform missions and promotional campaigns tied to its internal YBS token system. These rewards can be converted into betting funds or used as bonus cash, though they generally carry higher wagering requirements and are better suited for casual or promotional play rather than primary bankroll building.

Does Ybets Sportsbook Have a Rewards Program?

Yes, Ybets operates a rewards system that combines cashback, VIP status, and proprietary bonuses rather than a traditional points-based loyalty ladder.

20% Combined Sportsbook Cashback

Ybets offers one of the more aggressive cashback structures available to crypto bettors, extending it fully to sportsbook losses.

  • 10% Daily Cashback: Automatically credited each morning based on the previous day’s net sportsbook losses.
  • 10% Weekly Cashback: Claimed manually via a unique link posted every Thursday in the official Ybets Telegram channel.

Both cashback components carry a low 3x wagering requirement and are paid in real funds rather than abstract bonus points. Losses from live dealer games and baccarat are generally excluded unless VIP status is achieved, which often removes these restrictions.

VIP Club at Ybets Sportsbook

The VIP Club at Ybets does not separate casino and sportsbook play. Sports bettors with sufficient volume are eligible for the same high-tier benefits as casino players.

VIP status can be triggered automatically with a first deposit of $2,000 or more or assigned manually by VIP managers based on consistent activity and deposit patterns (typically $500+ deposits).

Once enrolled, bettors receive a personal VIP manager, higher withdrawal limits (up to $4,000 daily and $35,000 monthly), priority payouts, and access to exclusive reload bonuses that can often be used on sports betting.

YBS Tokens and Streamer Rewards

Ybets also issues its own internal digital currency, YBS. These tokens can be earned through platform missions and streamer interactions and converted into sportsbook or casino funds.

However, YBS bonuses usually carry higher wagering requirements—sometimes up to 60x—and are best treated as supplemental rewards rather than core value drivers.

Ybets Sportsbook Betting Options

Ybets Sportsbook offers extensive betting coverage across major and minor sports. Soccer is the most prominent, with markets available for leagues such as the English Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1, and competitions such as the UEFA Champions League and FIFA World Cup.

Other sports include basketball (NBA and global leagues), tennis (ATP and WTA Tour events, including the Australian Open, French Open, and the other Grand Slam tournaments), golf (including the Masters, PGA Championship, and other men’s majors), American football (NFL and college football), baseball (MLB and international leagues such as Japan’s NBO and Korea’s KBO), hockey (NHL and international leagues such as the KHL and Swedish Hockey League), rugby, cricket, and esports.

Common markets such as moneylines, point spreads, over/under bets, and standard prop bets are widely available. Expect deeper market depth for high-profile events such as the Super Bowl, NBA Finals, Champions League final, and FIFA World Cup.

Live betting is particularly robust, with dozens of in-play events available simultaneously across multiple sports.

Mobile Betting at Ybets Sportsbook

Ybets Sportsbook does not offer a dedicated mobile betting app. Instead, it does have a fully optimized mobile website, which closely mirrors the desktop experience.

Navigation remains smooth on smaller screens, with responsive menus, easy odds selection, and a functional live betting interface. For most users, the mobile browser experience is sufficient and eliminates the need for an app download.

Ybets Sportsbook Banking Options

Banking at Ybets Sportsbook reflects the platform’s broader crypto-first philosophy, with flexible deposit options, fast digital asset processing, and relatively light verification requirements for most routine activity.

For bettors who prefer to fund accounts with cryptocurrency, the cashier remains one of Ybets’ strongest functional advantages.

That said, the platform does enforce a few operational rules that are important to understand before requesting a withdrawal.

Cryptocurrency Banking

Ybets supports a wide range of cryptocurrencies and does not impose a formal minimum deposit for crypto transactions. However, bettors should note that a $50 deposit is required to unlock the platform’s Engine of Fortune rewards.

There is no clearly defined maximum withdrawal limit for crypto users, though very large payouts may be routed through a manual review process.

In practice, smaller and mid-range withdrawals tend to process quickly, with most crypto transactions completing within minutes to an hour depending on network congestion.

Supported cryptocurrencies include Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether (USDT), USD Coin (USDC), Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron (TRX), Polygon (POL), and Bitcoin Cash (BCH).

Traditional Banking

For players who prefer traditional payment methods, Ybets offers a broad selection of fiat options, including major cards and popular e-wallets.

Minimum fiat deposits generally start at around $20, though this can vary slightly by payment provider. Withdrawals cap at $1,000 per transaction, with standard monthly limits set at $10,000 for regular players.

VIP members benefit from significantly higher ceilings, with monthly withdrawal caps reaching $35,000 or more depending on account status.

Available fiat methods include Visa, Mastercard, Skrill, Neteller, Revolut, PaysafeCard, Interac, MiFinity, and region-specific options such as Pix and BLIK.

Important Wagering Requirement

One operational detail that often catches new users off guard is Ybets’ 3x wagering requirement on all deposited funds. Bettors must fulfill that requirement before attempting to make a withdrawal, regardless of the method of deposit. The platform enforces this as part of its anti–money laundering controls.

A 3x rollover is very modest compared to many crypto casinos and crypto sportsbooks, especially when it only applies to the deposited amount and does not include bonus funds. Still, it remains a key consideration for bettors who plan to deposit and withdraw quickly.

Customer Support

Ybets Sportsbook offers 24/7 customer support via live chat and email, with assistance available in more than 20 languages.

Email support is available at dm@ybets.io, and VIP players receive direct access to personal account managers. While support coverage is broad, response times may vary during withdrawal or security reviews.

Licensing and Security

Ybets Sportsbook is operated by Sigg Marketing Limited and licensed by the Anjouan Gaming Authority (Licence No. ALSI-202411003-FI1).

The sportsbook is marketed as a No-KYC platform, which is accurate for standard play. However, player reports in 2025 indicate that large withdrawals frequently trigger “security,” “provider,” or “betting” reviews, which can require full identity verification and extend payout timelines.

Also, standard security measures are in place to protect player data and financial transactions.

Conclusion

Ybets Sportsbook is a crypto-first betting platform built around live wagering, international sports coverage, and flexible crypto banking.

While it does not offer a sportsbook welcome bonus or any reload bonuses, it compensates with a solid 20% cashback system that applies to sports losses and provides consistent value for active bettors.

That said, players should be aware of potential withdrawal delays if significant winnings trigger a review, as well as the VIP system’s reliance on deposit volume rather than transparent loyalty points.

For experienced crypto bettors who prioritize live betting, cashback rewards, and higher limits, Ybets Sportsbook offers a functional and competitive option when approached with realistic expectations.

Ybets Sportsbook FAQ

Does Ybets Sportsbook have a welcome bonus?
No, Ybets Sportsbook does not currently offer a sportsbook welcome bonus. The platform focuses on cashback rewards rather than signup incentives.
Is there cashback on sports betting at Ybets?
Yes, Ybets offers a 20% cashback on sports betting losses. This is split into 10% daily cashback and a 10% weekly refund.
Can I bet with crypto at Ybets Sportsbook?
Yes, Ybets Sportsbook supports multiple cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and stablecoins. Crypto deposits and withdrawals do not have maximum limits.
Is KYC required at Ybets Sportsbook?
Ybets Sportsbook does not require KYC verification. However, large withdrawals may trigger a security review that requires verification.
Is Ybets Sportsbook available in the United States?
U.S. players can use a VPN to access Ybets Sportsbook, at their own discretion.
